z1-d01.title: Coat hooks (Easy)
z1-d01.html:

  • Om's umbrella is orange.
  • The person with the yellow umbrella and the person with the brown umbrella are next to each other.

z1-d02.html:

  • The cat owner lives on floor 5.

z1-d03.html:

z1-d05.html:
